title: MicroC2 R1 Run Manifest
description: One manifest per study run: an array of (seed, EDR slot) cells. Build-side fields are filled by lab/build_matrix.sh; EDR verdict and telemetry fields are filled per lab run following docs/research/r1-measurement-protocol.md.

manifest_version.description: Schema version of this manifest, e.g. "1.1".

study_id.description: Identifier for the study this manifest belongs to.

generated_by.description: Tool that generated the skeleton, e.g. "lab/build_matrix.sh".

generated_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp of skeleton generation.

seed.description: Mutation seed, hex u64 without 0x prefix (matches agent/build.sh --mutation-seed and provenance.json when present).

git_revision.description: Source revision the payload was built from (commit SHA).

path.description: Path to the payload artifact, relative to the manifest location.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the payload artifact, lowercase hex.

server_enrolled.description: True only when this exact artifact was built through the server and its bootstrap hash was activated for the selected build/listener. Standalone build_matrix.sh artifacts set this to false.

provenance_path.description: Path to the build's provenance.json, if present.

slot_id.description: Configurable slot identifier from the lab matrix (e.g. "slot-a").

product.description: EDR product name; null until the slot is assigned.

version.description: EDR product/engine version, including signature/content date where applicable.

run_started_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 payload execution start; null until the cell is run.

run_finished_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 end of dwell/evidence collection; null until the cell is run.

verdict.description: EDR verdict for this cell. "unknown" is both the pre-run placeholder and the verdict for invalid cells (see protocol §4).

alert_names.description: EDR alert/signature names raised during the cell window, as reported by the product console.

sysmon_evtx.description: Path to the exported Sysmon event log (.evtx).

etw_etl.description: Path to the ETW trace (.etl), where the study includes ETW capture.

agent_network_log.description: Path to the C2-side beacon/task log for this payload_id.

edr_export.description: Path to the EDR console export (alerts detail) for this cell.

notes.description: Free-text notes: deviations from protocol, static vs. behavioral attribution, slot table snapshot, etc.
